preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ T ≤ 10.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line) and N >= 1 and N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is the number of ingredient types, where 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**4 for x in A) for A in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, A is a list of N integers representing quantities of each ingredient type, where 1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^4.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == T for stdout in [stdin.splitlines()[i+2] for i in range(T)])
postconditions.description: Output exactly one integer per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output == -1) == any(A_i < 2 for A_i in A) for A, output in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If any ingredient type has fewer than 2 units (A_i < 2), output -1 for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output == sum(max(2, A_i) for A_i in A)) == all(A_i >= 2 for A_i in A) for A, output in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If all ingredient types have at least 2 units, output the sum of max(2, A_i) for all A_i in the test case.
